lara: heads-up: hitting an odd SSE resume bug in the ruby sample app when reconnecting immediately after abort. parser merges a trailing CR (`\r`) with next `data:` header so JSON.parse chokes.
ben: ruby-sdk version? can you paste raw bytes?
lara: ruby-sdk 1.8.0, sample-ruby-stream. repro: stream 6 small events, call `client.cancel_stream` on event 4, then reconnect. ~20% of the time the first event after reconnect fails with `JSON::ParserError`.
todd: can you show the raw frames you logged? curious about CR/LF combo.
lara: pasted sanitized dump below (we log raw chunk bytes):
```
data: {"i":1,"t":"x"}\r\n\r\n\

data: {"i":2,"t":"y"}\r\n\r\n\

data: {"i":3,"t":"z"}\r\n\r\n\r\n
<abort here>\n[data after reconnect arrives as:]
data: {"i":4,"t":"a"}\r\n\

data: {"i":5,"t":"b"}\r\n\r\n
```
ben: ah ok. server uses CRLF (`\r\n`) separators. abort seems to drop the final `\r` sometimes, turning `\r\n\r\n` into `\r\n\r` so the next `data:` gets prefixed and we get `..."}\r\ndata:` which our splitting logic doesn't handle.
todd: is the parser splitting strictly on `\r\n\r\n`? that would explain it.
lara: yes, simple split-on-separator approach in `lib/event_stream/parser.rb`. python sample was resilient because it normalizes newlines early.
ben: quick mitigation: normalize incoming buffer by replacing all `\r\n` with `\n` before tokenizing. small patch in ruby-sdk fixes it in my local run.
todd: also add a parse fallback: on parse error, try to split on `\ndata:` (after normalizing) and attempt to parse the trailing JSON pieces separately. keep a small partial buffer for incomplete JSON.
lara: implemented local fix: normalize CRLF->LF immediately, then split on double-newline; on JSON::ParserError try re-splitting on '\ndata:' and dedupe leading `data:` tokens. ran 1000 abort/reconnect cycles — zero failures locally.
ben: open PR and include a unit test that simulates `\r\n` separators and an abort that drops trailing `\r`. add note to sample README about `SDK_DEBUG=raw` and how to capture raw frames.
lar a: will do. also bumped ruby-sdk to 1.8.1 in the sample and added a short paragraph: "When you see intermittent parse errors on reconnect, enable raw logging and include the exact bytes; CRLF normalization fix landed in 1.8.1." (reacted :thumbsup:)
sdk-bot: CI job started for branch lara/fix-crlf-normalize  build #1902 queued.
ben: also consider adding a small reconnect jitter by default on the sample apps to reduce races (50ms). not mandatory but helpful.
todd: agree. for now push client-side parser fix first. server change to always emit an extra LF is risky.
lara: PR opened: https://git.redwood/example/prs/8899  includes tests + changelog. I'll update once CI finishes. last log: 2309876799
